tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Checks whether one local AI model fits one hardware setup - a graphics card, several identical cards ('2x RTX 3090') or a Mac - and returns the verdict (fits / tight / does_not_fit), memory needed (weights + context cache + overhead) against memory available, and generation speed in tokens per secon

tools.name: suggest_models
tools.description: Lists the largest known local AI models that fit on the given hardware at the given context length (default 8,192 tokens), up to 10, biggest first, each with its quantization, memory needed and speed in tokens per second (measured where LocalBit's node has run it, otherwise estimated). min_tokens_pe
